tip: about 是「繞著某件事打轉」,心思一直繞著它轉就是擔心。
example: Many employees are concerned about the changes in the new overtime policy.
exampleZh: 許多員工對新的加班政策變動感到擔心。

quiz.q: Our clients are concerned ___ the long delay in the shipping schedule.
quiz.explanation: concerned about=擔心某件事,客戶擔心的是出貨延誤。concerned for 多用在擔心某人的安危;be concerned with 是「與…有關、涉及」,主詞通常是報告或內容;concerned of 不成立。

tip: in 是人整個投入到某個領域「裡面」,興趣把你裝進去。
example: Several buyers are interested in our new line of ergonomic office chairs.
exampleZh: 好幾位買家對我們新一系列的人體工學辦公椅有興趣。

quiz.q: If you are interested ___ joining the training program, please sign up online.
quiz.explanation: interested in 後面接名詞或動名詞=對…有興趣。interested to 只接原形動詞且語氣是「很想知道」(interested to hear the result),接 joining 不通;on 常配 based;for 常配 responsible、eligible,都不與 interested 連用。

tip: for 指向「要交代的事項」,責任像箭頭往那件工作指過去。
example: Ms. Lin is responsible for training all the new sales representatives this month.
exampleZh: 林小姐這個月負責訓練所有新進的業務代表。

quiz.q: Who is responsible ___ checking the inventory before the store opens?
quiz.explanation: responsible for=負責某項工作。responsible to 後面要接「向誰報告」(responsible to the manager),接動名詞不通;of 常配 aware、proud;with 常配 familiar、satisfied,都無法帶出負責的事項。

tip: with 是「隨身帶著」,熟到這套知識像帶在身上一樣。
example: New interns should become familiar with the safety rules before Friday.
exampleZh: 新進實習生應該在星期五之前熟悉這些安全規則。

quiz.q: Are you familiar ___ the software we use for monthly expense reports?
quiz.explanation: (人)be familiar with(事物)=熟悉某事物。be familiar to 要把主詞換成事物,表示「對某人而言很熟悉」(The name is familiar to me);in 常配 interested、involved;of 常配 aware,都不能表達「某人熟悉某事」。

tip: with 是拿到手上的東西,滿意一定是「配著某個結果」來的。
example: The client was satisfied with the revised design we submitted last Friday.
exampleZh: 客戶對我們上週五送出的修改版設計很滿意。

quiz.q: Most guests were satisfied ___ the service at the hotel restaurant.
quiz.explanation: satisfied with=對某個結果或服務滿意,和 pleased with 同一組。for 常配 responsible、grateful;about 常配 concerned、worried;in 常配 interested、involved,這三個都不與 satisfied 連用。

tip: of 把「知道的內容」貼到你的腦袋上,像貼一張標籤。
example: Please be aware of the new deadline for submitting your travel receipts.
exampleZh: 請注意提交差旅收據的新期限。

quiz.q: The driver was not aware ___ the road closure until he reached the bridge.
quiz.explanation: aware of=察覺到、知道某件事。to 常配 similar、related;with 常配 familiar、equipped;on 常配 based,都不能接在 aware 後面帶出「知道的內容」。

tip: for 指向你「換得到」的東西,資格是通往那項福利的箭頭。
example: Full-time staff are eligible for the annual health checkup and dental care.
exampleZh: 全職員工有資格享有年度健康檢查與牙科照護。

quiz.q: Only members who joined before June are eligible ___ the special discount.
quiz.explanation: eligible for=有資格取得某項福利。with 常配 familiar、satisfied;of 常配 aware、capable;in 常配 interested、involved,都無法表示「符合資格」。若後面接動作,則改用 eligible to apply 這種不定詞形式。

tip: for 指出「開放給什麼用途」,東西空在那裡等著那個用途。
example: The conference room is available for client meetings after two o'clock.
exampleZh: 會議室兩點以後可供客戶會議使用。

quiz.q: Dr. Wang is available ___ a phone interview on Thursday morning.
quiz.explanation: available for=可供某用途、有空進行某活動。另有 available to+人(對某些人開放),但這裡接的是活動,要用 for;of 常配 aware、full;in 常配 involved;about 常配 concerned。

tip: for 指出「適合的對象」,像鞋子對上腳一樣配得起來。
example: This training video is suitable for both new hires and current employees.
exampleZh: 這支訓練影片適合新進人員與現職員工觀看。

quiz.q: The small meeting room is not suitable ___ a presentation to forty people.
quiz.explanation: suitable for=適合某用途或某對象。with 常配 familiar、equipped;to 常配 similar、related;in 常配 involved、interested,都無法表達「適合」。

tip: to 是一支箭頭指向比較對象,相似一定要有另一邊。
example: This year's sales figures are similar to those of the previous quarter.
exampleZh: 今年的銷售數字與上一季相近。

quiz.q: Her new job description is quite similar ___ the one she had in Taipei.
quiz.explanation: similar to=與…相似,後面接被比較的對象。similar with 是中文思維造成的常見錯誤;as 要用在 the same as;from 是 different from 的搭配,表示不同。

tip: from 是「從那邊分開」,差異就是分開後的距離。
example: The final version is quite different from the draft we discussed yesterday.
exampleZh: 最終版本與我們昨天討論的草稿相當不同。

quiz.q: This coffee tastes completely different ___ what I ordered last time.
quiz.explanation: different from=與…不同,是多益最標準的用法。about 常配 concerned;of 常配 aware、proud;with 常配 familiar、satisfied,都不與 different 連用;相反面要說 similar to。

tip: for 帶出「因為什麼而出名」,後面放的是名聲的原因。
example: The bakery is famous for its almond cookies and fresh milk bread.
exampleZh: 這家麵包店以杏仁餅乾和新鮮牛奶吐司聞名。

quiz.q: Kyoto is famous ___ its old temples and quiet stone gardens.
quiz.explanation: famous for=以某項特色聞名,後面放出名的原因。若要說「對某群人而言有名」則用 famous to;of 常配 aware、proud;with 常配 familiar;in 常配 involved。

tip: of 把驕傲的來源掛在身上,像胸前那面獎牌。
example: The manager is proud of how quickly the team solved the problem.
exampleZh: 經理對團隊這麼快解決問題感到驕傲。

quiz.q: My parents were very proud ___ me when I finished my first marathon.
quiz.explanation: proud of=為某人或某事感到驕傲。for 常配 famous、responsible;with 常配 pleased、satisfied;about 常配 concerned,都無法接出「驕傲的來源」。

tip: of 後面裝的是你身上帶著的能力內容,而且固定接動名詞。
example: The new printer is capable of handling large orders without overheating.
exampleZh: 這台新印表機能夠處理大量訂單而不會過熱。

quiz.q: She is capable ___ managing three projects at the same time.
quiz.explanation: capable of+動名詞=有能力做某事。要接原形動詞必須換成 able to;in 常配 involved、interested;for 常配 responsible、eligible,都不與 capable 搭配。

zh: 受制於…;可能有…變動;須經…
tip: to 是往下壓的方向,你被壓在某個規則或變動底下。
example: All prices are subject to change without prior notice to our customers.
exampleZh: 所有價格可能未經事先通知客戶即有變動。

quiz.q: The schedule is subject ___ approval by the head office in Osaka.
quiz.explanation: subject to=須經…核准、受制於…,後面接名詞或動名詞。of 常配 aware、proud;for 常配 responsible、eligible;with 常配 familiar,都無法表達「受某一方拘束」。

tip: for 帶出「感謝的事由」,感謝的對象是人時則改用 grateful to。
example: We are grateful for your patience while the system was being upgraded.
exampleZh: 感謝您在系統升級期間耐心等候。

quiz.q: I am grateful ___ all the advice you gave me before the interview.
quiz.explanation: grateful for+事情=為某件事感謝。grateful to+人 才是「感謝某個人」;of 常配 aware、proud;about 常配 concerned;with 常配 pleased、satisfied。

tip: to 是投入的方向,這裡的 to 是介系詞,後面要接動名詞。
example: Our company is committed to reducing packaging waste by next December.
exampleZh: 本公司致力於在明年十二月前減少包裝廢棄物。

quiz.q: The hotel is committed ___ providing quiet rooms for business travelers.
quiz.explanation: committed to+動名詞=致力於做某事,這個 to 不是不定詞,所以不能接原形動詞。for 常配 responsible、eligible;on 常配 based;with 常配 equipped、familiar。

tip: 和 committed to 是同一個 to,後面同樣接名詞或動名詞。
example: This floor is dedicated to research and development for medical devices.
exampleZh: 這一層樓專門用於醫療器材的研發。

quiz.q: The volunteer group is dedicated ___ helping elderly residents with daily shopping.
quiz.explanation: dedicated to+動名詞=致力於、專用於某事。for 常配 suitable、eligible;on 常配 based;in 常配 involved、interested,都不能接在 dedicated 後面。

tip: with 是「隨身帶著」,配備本來就是機器帶著的東西。
example: Every meeting room is equipped with a projector and a video camera.
exampleZh: 每間會議室都配備投影機與視訊攝影機。

quiz.q: The delivery vans are equipped ___ GPS devices to track every route.
quiz.explanation: equipped with=配備有某項設備。by 用來帶出被動語態的動作者(equipped by the supplier 指由誰安裝);of 常配 aware、full;for 常配 suitable,都不能帶出配備的內容。

tip: 和 satisfied with 同一組 with:結果拿到手裡,人才開心得起來。
example: The director was pleased with the results of the customer survey.
exampleZh: 總監對顧客問卷的結果感到滿意。

quiz.q: Everyone was pleased ___ the new office layout after the renovation.
quiz.explanation: pleased with=對某個結果感到滿意。pleased to 後面只接原形動詞(pleased to meet you);for 常配 grateful、famous;of 常配 proud;in 常配 interested。

tip: in 是人在事情「裡面」,參與就是整個泡在裡面。
example: Three departments were involved in preparing the annual budget report.
exampleZh: 有三個部門參與編製年度預算報告。

quiz.q: He was involved ___ a minor traffic accident on his way to the airport.
quiz.explanation: involved in=涉入、參與某事件。on 常配 based;to 常配 related、similar;for 常配 responsible;另有 involved with 偏向「與某人有牽扯」,用在單一事件並不自然。

tip: on 是踩在上面,基礎就是腳下踩著的那塊地。
example: The final decision was based on feedback from two hundred online users.
exampleZh: 最終決定是根據兩百位線上使用者的意見做出的。

quiz.q: The movie is based ___ a true story about a small fishing village.
quiz.explanation: based on=以…為依據。based in 是「總部或據點設在某地」(a company based in Taipei);of 常配 aware、full;with 常配 equipped,語意都不通。

tip: to 是一條連線,relate 就是把兩件事拉起一條線。
example: Please send all questions related to shipping directly to the logistics team.
exampleZh: 與出貨有關的問題請直接寄給物流團隊。

quiz.q: Most complaints this month were related ___ the slow response of customer service.
quiz.explanation: related to=與…有關,relate 這個字族固定搭 to。with 常配 familiar、equipped;on 常配 based;for 常配 responsible、suitable,都不能表達「有關聯」。

tip: 和 famous for 同一個 for,後面放「為人所知的原因」。
example: The supplier is known for delivering orders on time during busy seasons.
exampleZh: 這家供應商以旺季也準時交貨著稱。

quiz.q: That neighborhood is known ___ its weekend night market and cheap noodles.
quiz.explanation: known for=以某項特色著稱。known to+人 是「為某些人所知」;known as 則是「被稱為某種身分」;of 常配 aware;in 常配 involved,都不能帶出出名的原因。

tip: 門朝那個方向打開,to 後面就是歡迎進來的人或意見。
example: The committee is open to suggestions about the new recycling program.
exampleZh: 委員會歡迎大家對新回收方案提出建議。

quiz.q: The exhibition is open ___ the public from Tuesday through Sunday.
quiz.explanation: open to=對…開放、願意接受。open for 後面接的是用途或營業狀態(open for business、open for registration),接「人」不通;with 常配 familiar、equipped;on 常配 based,語意都不通。

tip: of 帶出「少掉的那樣東西」,離目標還差一段距離。
example: We are short of staff this weekend because two workers called in sick.
exampleZh: 這個週末我們人手不足,因為有兩位員工請病假。

quiz.q: The charity is still fifty thousand dollars short ___ its fundraising goal.
quiz.explanation: short of=差…、不足…,後面接缺少的東西或還沒達到的目標。from 常配 different、absent;to 常配 similar、related;in 常配 involved;記住 short of cash(現金不足)就記得這個 of。

tip: of 是容器裡裝的東西,說了「滿」就要說清楚裝什麼。
example: The warehouse is full of boxes waiting to be shipped this afternoon.
exampleZh: 倉庫裡堆滿了等著今天下午出貨的箱子。

quiz.q: Her report was full ___ useful charts and clear examples.
quiz.explanation: full of=充滿…。要用 with 必須換成 filled with(be filled with water);in 常配 interested、involved;by 用在被動語態的動作者,都不能接在 full 後面。

tip: free of 是「擺脫掉…」,擺脫收費就是免費。
example: Delivery is free of charge for orders over one thousand dollars.
exampleZh: 訂單滿一千元即免運費。

quiz.q: Guests can use the hotel gym free ___ charge during their stay.
quiz.explanation: free of charge=免費,是固定用法。free from 指「免於某種危害」(free from danger);for 常配 suitable、eligible;with 常配 equipped,都不能組成「免費」。

tip: from 是「從那個場合離開」,人不在那裡就是缺席。
example: Two board members were absent from the meeting due to a flight delay.
exampleZh: 兩位董事因班機延誤而缺席會議。

quiz.q: The student has been absent ___ class for three days in a row.
quiz.explanation: absent from=缺席某個場合。in 常配 involved、interested;of 常配 aware、short;to 常配 similar、related;和 different from 一樣,from 都帶著「離開、不在其中」的意象。

tip: with 是兩邊擺在一起看,對得起來就是一致。
example: The test results are consistent with the data we collected last month.
exampleZh: 測試結果與我們上個月收集的資料一致。

quiz.q: His explanation was not consistent ___ the statement he gave to the police.
quiz.explanation: consistent with=與另一份說法或資料相符。consistent in 是「在某方面始終如一」(consistent in quality),不能用來比對兩者;to 常配 similar、related;for 常配 responsible、suitable。
